status: development candidate with spatial STAP training support; not held out
selection: From first-eight-frame tissue-plus-noise statistics, among geometric regions with at least 40 pixels, two-view coherence >= 0.7 and bounded gain <= 4, choose highest minimum coherence with fixed candidate-order ties. Do not reselect from validation.
normalization_candidate: relative phase times per-view RMS amplitude from first eight frames
required_conditions: three-view 10% survey on unseen development seeds 2097 and 2101
three-view full-density survey on development seed 2063
full 80-frame source-resolved development scenes before filter freeze
decision: Passing input eligibility does not promote adaptive STAP or bounded normalization. Evaluate paired blood response and tissue leakage in moving tissue and slow/zero flow before any held-out freeze. Do not open 2081 or 2093 before full numerical code and settings are committed.
